title: P4124YHR corn (Pioneer P4124YHR): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: P4124YHR corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: P4124YHR corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety for Mindanao. About 115 days to harvest, 10.5 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: P4124YHR corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as Pioneer P4124YHR or P4124. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2018 as NSIC 2018 GMCn 55. Pioneer Hi Bred bred it. It takes about 115 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 10.5 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for Pioneer P4124YHR or P4124, this is the same corn. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry, with notes from its seller and farm sources. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng mais, step by step](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-mais).

**Yield:** 10.5 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

P4124YHR corn takes about 115 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is 9.6 days longer than the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 10.5 t/ha beats the average of its group, 8.13. It sits in the top quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 115 in NSIC trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [Corn rust](/diseases/corn-rust), [Corn stalk rot](/diseases/corn-stalk-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn planthopper](/pests/corn-planthopper). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its ears grew about 19.05 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 82.1 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears. Against lodging it rated resistant, so it stood up well when wind and rain pushed the plants.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** NSIC trials averaged 10.5 t/ha in Mindanao.
**Traits in the seed:** YHR / Intrasect (events MON810 x TC1507 x NK603): YieldGard and Herculex insect protection against corn borer plus Roundup Ready glyphosate tolerance.
Registry rates it resistant to lodging, corn borer, rust, stalk rot and earworm.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: pioneer's regular entry in DA 10's 2022 and 2023 Bukidnon and Misamis Oriental derbies. Check these against what farmers near you have seen, because the same variety can do differently from one town to the next.
Where and when to plant P4124YHR corn

The registry recommends it for Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is Pioneer P4124YHR the same as P4124YHR?
items.a: Yes. Pioneer P4124YHR is another name for P4124YHR, registered as NSIC 2018 GMCn 55. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 115 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 10.5 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
The registry recommends it for Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of P4124YHR?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
